messages.subject: [RESULT][VOTE] Airflow Providers - release preparation date 2026-04-08
messages.body:
Hello,

Apache Airflow Providers prepared on 2026-04-08 have been accepted.

3 "+1" binding votes received:

- Jarek Potiuk(binding)
- Jens Scheffler (binding)
- Buğra Öztürk (binding)

The providers are excluded from the release:
* common.compat
* openlineage
* amazon
* common.ai

Reasons:

* common.compat due to Airflow 2 compatibility (openlineage and amazon
depending on the new version of common.compat)
* common.ai due to HITL review issues on Airflow < 3.1 (-1 from Pavan).

The next RC candidates for those providers will be released as an ad-hoc
release on their own with accelerated vote period.

Vote thread:
https://lists.apache.org/thread/9r60zyhk90hgyyy2pprxj0t2v65vopjj

I'll continue with the release process, and the release announcement will
follow shortly.

Cheers,

Jarek
